note: Where the landmark stands on the campus map. Written by landmarks/pipeline/tools/data/place.py from the config's frame.expected; do not edit. Map metres: east and north of the campus origin, true north, as public/data/uoa/campus.json. In three.js (scene x east, y up, z south), put the model at (centre[0], the map's ground at door.map, -centre[1]) and turn it by rotationY about y; landmarks whose outlines come within 2 m of each other share one ground instead, each at its `ground` (the LiDAR's at the door) plus their mean of the map's ground at door.map minus `ground`, when those differences span 2 m or less (src/scene/landmarks.ts, standHeights). It stands in place of the blocks of `building` and of the buildings in `also`.
estimated: how thick its canopy and its roofs are, how deep the auditorium's fascia is, the size of its window's frames and head and how far they stand out, the radius of its downpipes, where its auditorium's walls stand on its courtyard and south edges (at the eave line), where the lower steps of its parapet to the car park begin (to about 0.25 m), how high the steps between the LiDAR's levels stand (equal rises), and the colour of the walls no photograph shows
